content: Cristo-gannar-durgusad-igar
Gwenadgan, emigindi an bemarga Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi-sunmakapid bemar ebinsamarsun. A-gayaburba-nued bemar abingasmalad, abali, amba bemar galakusuli nanadimalad.
Deginbali, an bemarga Gayaburba-Nuedgi-sunmaksadba bemar nue nanadiile, egi be abonolesmardo, ar bemar unnila asginbi bengusur gussurmalar.
Igi an odurdaklesmoga, ayob an bemar-odurdaksamarmogad: Cristo anmar-isgued-ular burgwisad, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naidyob, gunonikid.
Cristo napa-urba diglesad, degine, ibapaagi gannar durgusad, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naidyob, gunonikid.
Cristo gannar durgusgu, Cefasʼse na magarosad. We-Cefasʼde, Pedroʼye nugbalid. A-sorba, Cristo e-ambe-gakabogwadse (12) magarosbalid.
A-sorba gwenadgan-e-dulataled-ilatar-gwena-bukwadse (500+) magarosbalid, a-gwenadgan amba bukidar dula gudidiid, abar bato burgwismarbalid.
A-sorba, Jacoboʼse Jesús magarosad. A-sorbali, e-sapingan-bur-dummaganse magarosbalid.
Geb a-sorba, napidgi, Cristo anse magarosmogad. An dule-wargwen gwaluleged-e-ibagan-maisulidba gwalulesayob, an gunonikid.
Ar ani an Bab-Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummagan-e-solabalidid. Degine, Jesús-e-sapin-bur-dummadga-gumogaga an nugsalegewilubsulinad, ar ade, Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-baregindii an gusad-duled.

Ar Bab-Dummad nabir angi binsasadbali, ar emigindi an a-dulega gunonido. A-ular, weyob an gudisunnad. Ar Bab-Dummad angi arbasadi, binsarsunna arbassulid. Ar ade, emarba an bur bule arbasad. Ar ani an arbassulid, Bab-Dummad gangued-anga-uksadba an deyob arbasad.
Degisoggu, andibe, Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummagan-baigandibe, anmar bemarga weyob Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmaksamalad, degine, bemar weyob A-Gayaburba-Nued abingasmalad.
Dule-burgwismalad-gannar-durguoed-igar
Ar Cristoʼgi sunmaklediile, Cristo burgwisgu, gannar durgusye, ¿ar degite, ibiga bemar-abargi gwen-gwen sogsunna, dule burgwisale, gannar bar-durguosurye?
Ar dule burgwisale, gannar bar durgusulile, Cristo burgwisgu, gannar bar-durgussurmodo.
Ar Cristo gannar durgussulile, binsa Bab-Igargi anmar sunmakdido, degine, bemar binsa Cristoʼgi bensuli gudimardo.
Degisoggu, anmar gakanba binsa Bab-Dummad-barsogdimarsundo, ar ade, anmar sogdiid, “Bab-Dummad Cristo-burgwisad gannar odulosye.” Ar burgwismalad gannar durgusulile, Bab-Dummad Cristo-odulossurdo.
Ar burgwismalad gannar durgusulile, Cristo gannar durgussurmodo.
Ar Cristo gannar durgussulile, binsa bemar Jesúsʼgi bensuli gudimardo. Ar degisoggu, amba bemar be-isguedgi gudimarsundo.
Degisoggu, Cristoʼba-nai-burgwismalad abonolessurmarmosundo.
Ar Cristo unnila we-napnegginedginbi anmarga ibmar-nuedga guele, anmar bela dulemar-we-napnegginmaladba nue-wiledimardo.
Emigindi, Cristo dule-burgwismalad-abargi gannar durgusad. Cristo gannar-durgusadgi, dule-burgwismalad-iduedga gunonisunnad.
Ar dule-wargwengi burgwed-igar nonisoggu, dule-wargwengi gannar-durgued-igar nonibardo.
Ar igi bela dulemarga Adánʼgi burgwed-igar noniki, debayobi, bela dulemar Cristoʼgi durgunonimaloed.
Dule-burgwismalad Bab-Dummad-igar-mesisadba gannar durgunonimaloed: Cristo-inse durgusad, geb a-sorba, Cristo gannar danikile, eba-nanaimalad gannar odurgunonikoed.

Degi, geb neg-bergued nonikoed, bela burbar-dummagan-negsemamaid, bela burbar-sailaganga-gumaid, degine, bela burbar-gandikidba-gangued-nikmalad osulosale, geb degi, Cristo na e-ganguedba negdakmaid, Bab-Dummadga-gumaidga na uknonikoed.
Ar Cristo bela e-isdarmalad-birgi-nakwedse negsemai guergebed.
Cristo solaba e-isdarad-napi-osulogoedi, burgwedid.
Salmo 8:6 Degisoggu, mag-itoledo, Bab-Dummaddi Cristo-urbaligwa gunonisulid, ar ade, Bab-Dummad bela Cristo-urba ibmar urbisad.

Ar bela ibmar Cristo-urba urbilenonikile, geb Cristo Bab-Dummad-Machi na e-sunnad Bab-Dummad-urbaligwa nanadoed, ar ade, Bab-Dummad bela Cristoʼga ibmar uksad. Geb agi bela Bab-Dummad-sogedba ibmar gunonisunnoed.

Deginbali, gannar-durguleged-igar sulile, degite, ¿ibiga burgwarmalad-anar Bab-diigi-ogleged-igar imakmarsunna? Ar dule-burgwarmalad durgusulile, degite, ¿ibiga burgwarmalad-anar Bab-diigi-ogleged-igar imakmarsunna?
Ar degite, anmar ¿ibiga wachi-iliba boni-abargi gudimarsunna?
Gwenadgan, napira an bemarga soged, bemar Bab-Jesucristoʼba-naidba, igi an weligwar itoge, ayobi, napiragwadba an bemarga sogbalid, an bane-bane burgwednaga gudiid.
Ar we-napneggi-gudiguedbi nikale, ibmar-baid satele, ¿ibiga an Éfeso-neggweburgi achu-ursilimarbo garitodii gussunna? Ar dule-burgwarmalad durgusulile,
Isaías 22:13
Mer be yardaklemar: “Dulemar-nuegan, dulemar-isganaba-akaele, isguddamalad.”
Nue be binsamar, mer bar be isgumar, isguedgi be nomar. Bemar-obingesaegala an bemarga soged, bemar bukidar amba Bab-Dummad-nue-wissuli gudimalad.
Dulemar igi gannar durgumaloe
Ar gwenna-gwenna egisdamaloed, degite: “¿Dule-burgwismalad igi gannar durguoe? ¿Igi e-san daklegosunna?”
¿Aku be itosi? Ar ibmar-gwag-niega be ibmar-gwag-digedi, ¿bina ibmar-gwag-e-uka nunguergebsursi?
Be oros-gwaggi-dakleged digdibe, be ibmar-gwag-baid digdibe, e-war-sunnad be digsulid, e-gwag be diged.
Ar Bab-Dummad ega e-san-ukedi, na igi-dakle ega ukbiedba uked. Degine, ibmar-gwaggala na egad-egadba e-san ega uked.
Ar sanmar bela emarbi daklesulid. Dulemar-san akar-dakleged, ibdula-sanmar akar-daklemogad, ibmar-gukuarmalad-san akarmogad, degine, uamar-san akarmogad.
Amba deyobmodo, nibneggined san-nikmogad, degine, napneggined san-nikmogad. Nibneggined-e-san-daklegedi, napneggined-e-sanbo akar dakleged. Degine, e-yeerdakleged ebo akar daklebalid.
Dad-ibeler-gaed, nii-gaed-ebo, akalad, degine, niisgwamar-gaed amba akarmogad. Ar niisgwamar na akar-akar-gaed nikananaed.
Amba deyobi, dule-gannar-durguedsik gumogoed. Dule burgwisale, diglesale, e-san nungudoed. Ar gannar-durgusad-sorbardi, bar nunguosulid.
Degi, dule-san isdar-daklegedgi digleged. Durgunonikogudi, yeerdakle durgunonikoed. Dule-san nollogwadgi digleged. Durgunonikile, nollosulidgi durgunonikoed.
Degine, dule burgwisale, e-san-we-napneggined digleged. Durgudagogudii, bato san-gwagsa san-burbaled-nika durgudagoed. We-napneggined-san-nikale, burbaled-san nikamodo.
Ar weyob Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaid:
Génesis 2:7 Adán-napid, Cristoʼd. Cristoʼdi, dulega burba-dulad uked.
Ar san-burbaled-inse nonisulid, san-we-napneggined-inse nonikid. Geb a-sorba, san-burbaled nonikid.
Dule-gebe-we-napneggi-aideged, unnila we-napnegginedid. Dule sorba-nonimogadi, adi, nibnegginedid.
Adán-san-nikusmaladyob we-napnegginmalad san-nikmarmogad. Ar Cristoʼba-nanaimaladdi, Cristoʼyob san nikumarmogoed.
Ar igi anmar dule-we-napnegginedyobi daklemala, deyobi, anmar dule-nibneggi-danikidyobi daklemarmogoed.
Gwenadgan, we an bemarga sogdo, ar san-we-napneggined, geg Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidse doged. Deginbali, ar ibmar-nunguoed nibneg-geg-nunguedse geg dogbalid.
Burgwedgi anmar nakwemaloed
Igar-dukuar-maid an bemarga soggwelo: Bela anmar burgoedbisurmalad, degi-inigwele, bela anmar-san gwagoedbiid.

Ar napi-gar-trompeta-goloedgi, anmar-san ukiar, anmar ibya-muru-sade-daedyob gwagoed. Ar ade, gar-trompeta goloed, geb agi dulemar-burgwismalad durgudagoed, san-gwapid-geg-nungued-nika durgudagoed. Degine, anmarmoga, anmar-san gwagdemarmogoed.
Ar ade, we anmar-san-nabir-nunguedi, gwagergebed, san-gwapid-geg-nunguedga guergebed. Degi, anmar-san-nabir-burgwedi, gwagergebed, san-geg-bar-burgwedga guergebed.
We anmar-san-nabir-nunguedi geg-bar-nungue gusale, anmar-san-sunna-burgwedi geg-bar-burgwe gusale, geb agi, Bab-Dummad-Garda-narmakar-maidba gunonisunnoed:
Isaías 25:8 Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaibalid:
Oseas 13:14
Ar burgwed-e-bonigana, isguedid, degine, Moisés-Igar-Mesisad isguedga gangued uksad.
Anmar emigindi, anmar Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye sogmarsundo, ar anmar-Dummad-Jesucristoʼba burgwed-igargi-nakwega anmar-imaknonikid.

Degisoggu gwenadgan-sabemalad, gatik gannaa be imakmar, mer be galakumalo, gatik Bab-Jesús-Igargi arbanai be gumar. Ar bemar wisid, emi, bemar Bab-Jesús-Igargi arbananaid, binsa be alamaknanaisulid, bemarga igar-nuedga gumaloed.
